reason: Our ERP already has a student app, and I am not putting another vendor in front of students and asking IT to open up Microsoft 365 and the ERP to a small startup nobody has vouched for. The free pilot is tempting, but I would want to talk to two or three colleges already using it before I even take it to IT.
objection: No names of other colleges using it. I cannot ask our IT team for access to student data, DPDP agreement or not, on the word of a startup I found myself, and if it is just a second app duplicating the ERP one, students will ignore both.
would_change_my_mind: A call with the registrar of a comparable private university that has run it for at least a term and can show me their missed-exam-notice complaints actually went down.
